messages:
Marta: Quick PSA 10am folks 12 — my birthday is next Thursday. If anyone wants to drop a micro celebration (tiny cake, snacks, or a silly office hat), Id be delighted but no pressure at all.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Post birthday celebration plans and sign-ups in #people-ops. Use the shared doc for logistics: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-bday-helpers
Ravi: Im in the SF office that day and can bring a small box of donuts. Vegan options ok?
Marta: Donuts sound perfect. Vegan would be lovely but not required.
Samira: I can make a 2-min acoustic happy birthday song if people want a brief in-person serenade :guitar:
Ike: Vote reaction: :doughnut: donuts, :cupcake: cupcakes, :bento: savory snack.
Ravi: Adding a note 10am mini-break at 10:15am PT to keep it short. If remote, drop a gif or 5-10s clip and well play it during the break.
people-ops-bot: people-ops notified  suggested per-person contribution $5-15. Link to sign-up: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-bday-helpers (edit by Ravi).
Samira: Dress code for the occasion: optional party hat. I can bring two paper crowns.
Marta: Love the hat idea. If anyone wants to add a one-liner to the card, post here and Ill copy them into the physical card.
Ike: "Happy birthday Marta! Keep shipping the tiny wins."
Ravi: "To more coffee-fueled debugging and fewer 2am alerts."
Samira: "Youre the reason our standups are shorter and happier."
people-ops-bot: Sign-up sheet updated by Ravi. Last edit: 1800456901.
Marta: This is so sweet, thank you. Ill be in the office that morning. No big fuss, just feel the love :heart:
Ike: Final plan: donuts (with a couple vegan boxes), two paper crowns, 10:15am quick break in the kitchen. See you then!
